themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, or introduce various AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as articles, transcripts, or reports, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI affects job roles, recruitment, skills, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles focusing on the use, capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI chatbots in various research contexts.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content that reviews, compares, or benchmarks the effectiveness and value of specific AI tools for UX and research.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles exploring AI applications that directly support the design process and user research activities.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content concerning the creation and use of artificial or simulated user profiles for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discussions about integrated platforms or environments that offer a suite of AI tools for research.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
